nol.evidence: David 2026-10-30: "Figure out the NOL's from Matt." Value [D]: 10-K FY2025 Note (income taxes), p.160: 'As of December 31, 2025, the total amount of net operating losses carried forward under the Dutch tax regime was EUR 458.9 million ($ 539.2 million)' ... 'Net operating loss carryforwards subject to a limit of offsetting taxable profit in excess of EUR 1.0 million to 50% of the taxable profit can be carried forward indefinitely.' US federal NOLs ~$20.1M (expire 2036-37; US ops already taxable) are not added. Q2 2026 10-Q discloses no updated NOL balance. Finagle mechanics (company.py _calc_fcf_from_ebitda): NOL offsets 100% of pre-tax income with no cap and no EUR 1M threshold. Adjustment [S]: none. In base/bull FY2027E-FY2028E pre-tax income is large enough that a 50% cap only defers part of the shield by about one year; in bear the NOL is never used. Units: US$ millions.
